brief:
**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, Virginia, the School Board appointed Freddie Elswick as interim Northwestern District member on October 29 to fill a vacancy. In nearby Princeton, West Virginia (Mercer County), a 12-year Princeton Police Department lieutenant was arrested October 28 on first-degree arson charges tied to an August fire. A joint undercover operation in McDowell and Wyoming counties netted four arrests for alleged child exploitation. Mercer County reported over 3,000 early votes cast as of October 29, while a new Halloween-themed store opened in Bluefield, Virginia. No active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in the core area.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/30/tazewell-county-school-board-appoints-interim-member/)[[2]](https://www.wtap.com/2026/10/28/princeton-police-officer-arrested-arson-charges/)[[3]](https://woay.com/four-arrested-for-attempting-to-solicit-minors-in-joint-operation-by-mcdowell-wyoming-sheriffs-office/)[[4]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/more-than-3-000-have-now-voted-early-in-mercer/article_96330958-bad5-4fac-b9be-68c1b607bff8.html)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Princeton, Mercer County, WV:** Lt. Ronald Mathew Combs (also referred to as R.M. Combs), a 12-year veteran of the Princeton Police Department, was arrested October 28, 2026, on a first-degree arson charge. The charge stems from a structure fire on August 4, 2026, in the 900 block of Harrison Street in Princeton. Combs was placed on administrative leave/suspended without pay pending internal and criminal investigations; the city and department cooperated fully. West Virginia State Police assisted with the arrest. He was taken to Mercer County Magistrate Court for arraignment; no bond information was immediately available.[[2]](https://www.wtap.com/2026/10/28/princeton-police-officer-arrested-arson-charges/)

**McDowell County and Wyoming County, WV:** Four men were arrested in “Operation Black Lantern,” a joint undercover child exploitation sting by the McDowell County Sheriff’s Office, Wyoming County Sheriff’s Office, and Veterans 4 Child Rescue. The operation ran over five days and targeted individuals allegedly attempting to solicit and meet minors believed to be under 16.[[3]](https://woay.com/four-arrested-for-attempting-to-solicit-minors-in-joint-operation-by-mcdowell-wyoming-sheriffs-office/)

- Jonathan Cole Rutan, 27, of Ripley, WV: Charged with soliciting via computer, soliciting and traveling to engage in sexual acts with a minor, and possession of a firearm while committing a felony. Bond set at $125,000 (McDowell County Magistrate Ron Blevins).
- Marlon Enrique Perez (of El Salvador): Charged with soliciting via computer and soliciting and traveling to engage in sexual acts with a minor; also faces immigration-related issues as he is reportedly unlawfully present in the U.S. Bond set at $90,000.
- John Michael Beckwith, 44, of Charleston, WV: Charged with soliciting via computer and soliciting and traveling to engage in sexual acts with a minor. Bond set at $90,000.
- Austin Hunter Cox, 36, of Blountville, TN: Charged with soliciting and traveling to engage in prohibited sexual activity and obstructing an officer. Bond set at $151,000.

Three were arrested in McDowell County and one in Wyoming County; all remained in custody as of the latest reports.[[5]](https://wchstv.com/news/local/joint-child-exploitation-operation-in-wyoming-mcdowell-counties-nets-four-arrests)

**Tazewell County, VA / Mercer County, WV area:** No other verified arrests, pursuits, seizures, or court outcomes reported in the last 24 hours from core agencies.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
No active NWS alerts. No flooding, winter weather, burn bans, power outages, boil-water notices, or major VDOT/WVDOH closures reported on key routes (US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, Route 67, I-77) in the core area. Mercer County Sheriff’s Department issued a reminder for motorists to prepare for winter.[[6]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/28/four-men-face-charges-after-child-exploitation-sting-southern-west-virginia/)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County, VA:** The Tazewell County School Board appointed Freddie Elswick as interim member for the Northwestern District seat on October 29, 2026 (sworn in by Circuit Court Clerk Charity Hurst). Elswick, a Richlands High School and University of Tennessee graduate and general manager of Ramey Automotive in Richlands, replaces Donna Lawson Culbertson following her resignation. He has extensive local youth involvement, including coaching and founding the Blue Tornado Touchdown Club.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/30/tazewell-county-school-board-appoints-interim-member/)

**Mercer County, WV:** More than 3,000 early votes (3,030 as of October 29 afternoon) have been cast across the three early voting precincts (Mercer County Courthouse in Princeton, Herb Sims Wellness Center in Bluefield, and Covenant Baptist Church in Princeton). Early voting continues through Saturday, October 31.[[4]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/more-than-3-000-have-now-voted-early-in-mercer/article_96330958-bad5-4fac-b9be-68c1b607bff8.html)

**Bluefield, WV:** A vehicle insurance ordinance was adopted to align with West Virginia code (reported October 29). A major bridge rehabilitation project is underway in the city.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Bluefield, VA (Tazewell County):** Sweet Screams, a new Halloween- and fall-themed store on Virginia Avenue (formerly Grey and Honey women’s clothing store), opened just in time for Halloween. Owner David Comer aims to create a nostalgic, family-friendly experience drawing from 1980s vibes and his book series *The Dream Diary*; the store will continue selling some clothing items including prom dresses.[[7]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/sweet-screams-opens-just-in-time-for-halloween-in-bluefield-va/)

**Bluefield, WV area:** Bluefield Rotary is hosting a community rally to celebrate local service (October 30 report).

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Early voting continues in Mercer County, WV, through Saturday, October 31 (last day).
- Tazewell County, VA, early voting also runs through Saturday at the voter registration office in North Tazewell.
- No scheduled major meetings, court dates, or forecast hazards noted in core sources. Halloween events and preparations ongoing locally.
